# Get Started

## Installation

First install it.

```bash
npm install --save-dev @zeta-gds/components
```

## Usage

Add the following lines in you entry point js file.

```js
import ZetaGalaxyComponents from '@zeta-gds/components'
import 'zeta-gds/dist/lib/index.css'

Vue.use(ZetaGalaxyComponents)
```
